Live Preview, file management in the sidebar, and Malgel in French, Spanish, Chinese and Japanese. More at [www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## New

- **Live Preview (Ctrl+4, or ⌘4 on macOS).** Write in the formatted document, as in Obsidian. The paragraph, heading, list item or table cell you're in keeps its look, and Markdown marks like `**` or `[…](…)` appear only around the caret, so a bold word stays bold while you edit it. Click anywhere to edit right there. Arrow keys move on through items, cells and paragraphs. Enter starts the next list item or paragraph, and ends a list or quote from an empty line. Tab nests list items and moves between table cells, and Ctrl-click (⌘-click) follows a link. Code blocks, callouts and HTML are edited as written. Formatting commands, undo and paste work as they do in the editor. Pick it from **View → Live Preview** or the new button in the title bar.
- **Manage files from the sidebar.** Create files and folders, rename them in place, and delete them to the trash, from the buttons at the top of the sidebar or by right-clicking. Drag a file or folder onto another folder to move it. Documents you have open follow their files when they're renamed or moved.
- **In your language.** The interface is now in English, French, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. It follows your system's language, or you can pick one in Settings. These translations are new, and reviews and corrections from native speakers are welcome: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/rcawston/Malgel/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#translations).
- **Update check.** Malgel now tells you when a newer version is out. On startup it asks GitHub for the latest release and, if there's a newer one, offers to open its page. It sends nothing else and installs nothing for you. Turn it off in Settings, or check any time with **Help → Check for updates…** (in the Malgel menu on macOS).
- **`<details>` sections open and close.** A `<details>` with a `<summary>` shows only its summary until you click it; `<details open>` starts open. Markdown inside, between blank lines, renders as usual.
- **Centered and right-aligned content.** `align="center"` or `align="right"` on `<div>`, `<p>` and headings, `style="text-align: …"`, and `<center>` align what's inside. The logo, badges and title at the top of many READMEs now look as they do on GitHub.
- **Exports keep them.** HTML export keeps `<details>` and alignment. PDF and Word exports print sections open, with their summary in bold. Images sized with `<img width="…">` keep that size.

## Changed

- The zoom commands moved into a **View → Zoom** submenu.
- Built on GPUI Kit 0.8.1.

## Fixed

- Images in GitHub alerts now load when their paths are relative to the document.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Malgel-0.1.3-macos-universal.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.3-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.3-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.3-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed and notarized. The Windows files aren't signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time: choose **More info → Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
